faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: We'll reschedule at no extra cost. Overcast days actually make for great portraits — heavy rain is where we draw the line.

faq.q: Can I bring friends or family?
faq.a: Yes, a few photos with friends or family can be worked into any session — just mention it when booking. For larger groups, look at Crew or The Works.

faq.q: What's the difference between Crew and The Works?
faq.a: Crew is group shots only. The Works adds an individual solo set for each person, plus more time and locations.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside of Davis?
faq.a: Yes, I'm available throughout the Bay Area and Sacramento. A travel fee may apply beyond 30 miles from Davis or Berkeley.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: Venmo and Zelle. Group bookings can pay separately — no need to collect cash from friends.
